name: locator_inconsistent
description: A deliberately corrupt record: flagged locator_unavailable while still citable and still rendering a locator. No corpus chunk looks like this — validate.py treats it as fatal — and the fixture exists to prove the citation validator refuses it rather than picking whichever half of the contradiction it likes.
query: What are not inventions under the Patents Act?

results.text: 3.
